Add two: "not a cloud in sight, honestly a perfect day to be outside" = not1 a2 cloud3 in4 sight5 honestly6 a7 perfect8 day9 to10 be11 outside12 = 12. Close enough to "about 13."

Checking total character count: prefix "Wind 0 km/h S. Barometer 1023.3 " is about 34 characters + space + suffix. No problem, well under 280.

Suitable and casual, no hashtags or links. I'll go with "not a cloud in sight, honestly a perfect day to be outside".

I'll write to /app/answer.txt.
